answer_1.quote: We focus on unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) of Question Generation (QG) and Passage Retrieval (IR) from generic domains such as Wikipedia to target domains.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate question generation using standard language generation metrics: BLEU1-4, METEOR and ROUGE L.

answer_4.quote: We report human evaluation of QG by sampling 50 generated questions from MLQuestions test set and asking three domain experts to rate a question as good or bad based on four attributes: Naturalness, i.e., fluency and grammatical correctness; Coverage, i.e., whether question covers the whole passage or only part of the passage; Factual Correctness in ML domain; Answerability, i.e., if the question can be answered using the passage.
answer_4.guideline: Domain experts rated questions as good or bad using four attributes.
